title: Add GitHub issue reader for Daedalus planner
body:
## Description
Create a module to ingest GitHub issues and extract task directives for Daedalus.

## Acceptance criteria
- Parse GitHub issue JSON correctly
- Extract risk keywords (auth, deploy, secrets, etc.)
- Classify risk level (GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/CRITICAL)
- Detect no-go areas
- Handle malformed input gracefully

## Affected modules
- planner
- aegis

## Constraints
- Test-only (no production changes)
- Must pass security scan
- Coverage >= 80%
